notes: two sayings in one report: «الدينار بالدينار» (Abu Sa'id's words) and «لا ربا إلا في النسيئة» with its own isnad «أخبرني أسامة»: the second saying with its own isnad is a ruling case (rule 11); the route written is that of the first saying, ending at Abu Sa'id
«فقال أبو سعيد سألته» and the questions are in the scene, not links
